meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE (agriculture ministry and food ministry data), via the Data Bank
meta.revisionPolicy: Advance estimates are revised until the ministry's final estimates; final figures change rarely. The latest year is kept apart as an advance estimate, never joined to the final years.
meta.coverage: States x 9 crops, production, 2022-23 (third advance estimates)
meta.note: State-wise production of foodgrains and major non-foodgrain crops (DBIE report 465; RBI Handbook table 16D), thousand tonnes; cotton in thousand bales of 170 kg, raw jute and mesta in thousand bales of 180 kg. All India includes the union territories. Boundary changes are separate series, never joined: Madhya Pradesh, Bihar and Uttar Pradesh are the undivided states to 1999-2000 (Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand and Uttarakhand from 2000-01); Andhra Pradesh is the undivided state to 2014-15 (Telangana from 2015-16, as the table prints it); Jammu and Kashmir is the state with Ladakh to 2018-19 and the union territory from 2019-20 (RBI's note 8 says 2019-20 still covers the undivided state; the table keys it with the union territory). Before 1980-81 the table carries All India only. This bundle is 2022-23 alone, on the ministry's third advance estimates: a different ruler from the final years, never joined. RBI's Handbook of Statistics on Indian States carries later years for each state (the states guide's bundles states-hbs-t058 to t066).
